description: Token safety verdicts for up to 25 tokens in one call — one row per token: verdict (safe/caution/risky/danger), score 0-100, risk level, flags (honeypot, sell tax, mintable, hidden owner, holder concentration, low liquidity), liquidity, holders, top-10 share, price; plus counts per verdict and a not_found list. Base by default; also ethereum, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, solana. 404/free if no token is known; 503/free if the sources are down. Costs $0.10 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
